title: Scalable and Transferable Black-Box Jailbreaks for Language Models via Persona Modulation

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting harmful completions using automated persona-modulation jailbreaks (e.g., asking for thoughts on differences between ethnic groups) and evaluating the responses using a GPT-4 zero-shot classifier (PICT) to detect racist content.
Using persona-modulated prompts to elicit sexist responses regarding the roles of men and women in society, with the output evaluated for harmfulness by an automated LLM classifier.

Prompting the target model with a harmful persona to share perspectives on different sexual orientations, and classifying the resulting completions for homophobia using a GPT-4 content moderator prompt.
Eliciting religiously intolerant responses by asking the model to describe differences between religions under a specific persona, followed by automated evaluation using the PICT classifier.
Applying persona-modulation jailbreaks to elicit xenophobic responses about different cultures and evaluating the generation's harmfulness with a zero-shot LLM judge.
Prompting the model to describe differences between people with varying physical and mental abilities using a harmful persona, then scoring the response for ableist content using a GPT-4 classifier.
Requesting the model's views on different age groups via persona modulation and using an automated LLM classifier to detect ageist harmful content.
Using persona modulation to elicit responses promoting body shaming based on physical appearances, and evaluating the harmfulness of the output with an LLM-based zero-shot classifier.
